关键词: Amended and Restated Loan and Security Agreement
主要内容: On January 8, 2013, Medallion Financial Corp. entered into an amendment to its Amended and Restated Loan and Security Agreement, dated March 28, 2011, by and among the Company, Medallion Funding LLC, and Sterling National Bank. Under the terms of the amendment, the maturity date of Facility A was extended to June 30, 2014, and the maturity date of Facility B was extended to June 30, 2015. Other technical changes were also implemented. The amendment is attached as an exhibit to the Form 8-K filing and is incorporated by reference in its entirety. The amendment affects the Company's financial obligations and its relationship with Sterling National Bank, potentially impacting its liquidity and capital structure within the financial services industry.
